I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I said I'd noted that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June, not the date she posted in #north-team, and that I won't do anything about it, since she said no action was needed.

I didn't open #north-team or any other source to compare dates. The correction comes from Ilse, and a renewal date isn't a finance figure, so repeating it in the same conversation is fine.
